segments.text: The main heroine. Emilia is a half-elf who is one of the candidates to become the next ruler in the royal election making her 42nd King of Lugnica. Among the half breeds and other discriminated or disfranchised races and people in Luginca, she is seen as their hope for a better future due to her ideal of better social equality. She always regards Subaru as a mischievous child who needs to be taken care of. Emilia is good natured and likes to take care of others, though Emilia herself refuses to admit it, instead thinking of it as her own selfishness. She is indifferent to her own appearance, leaving Pack to take care of her clothes and hair.
Edited from both Wikipedia & Re:Zero Wiki

A hikikomori and gamer who suddenly finds himself transported to another world on his way home from the convenience store. There, he meets a silver-haired half-elf girl named Emilia, and falls deeply in love with her. Upon his arrival, Subaru acquires an ability which he calls "Return by Death", that allows him to go back in time when he dies, while still retaining his memories of the previous timeline. He is unable to tell anyone about his power, because any attempt to do so causes him to black out momentarily as black hands emerge to squeeze his heart, and may even kill those around him; it also causes him to give off the "scent of the Jealous Witch", which attracts "mabeasts" (magical creatures), and is repulsive to those who can detect it.
From Wikipedia

One of the twin demons who work at Roswaal's mansion as maids, Rem is Ram's younger sister. Her cooking skills are much better than her sister's. Rem tends to speak in a superficially polite manner and sometimes acts without thinking. Because of her respect and guilt toward her sister, she used to think of herself as inferior. After Subaru saves her, she falls deeply in love with him, becoming one of his most loyal followers. Rem will stick with him no matter what happens, even if Subaru rejects himself.
Edited from Re:Zero Wiki

One of the twin demons who work at Roswaal's mansion as maids and Rem's older sister. Ram is seemingly self centered and does things at her own pace, however in actuality she maintains a distance from people to ascertain them. She believes that Roswaal is the greatest and no one else is as precious except for her sister Rem. She is slightly more outgoing in comparison to the generally taciturn Rem, who generally allows Ram to take the lead in their sisterly bond.
From Re:Zero Wiki

A thief who grew up in the slums of the capital. Felt is a stickler when it comes to money due to living in the slums and she hates losing. She cares about Rom, the giant who takes care of her, especially when it comes to appraisals in price. Her appearance is considered to be a sign of having royal blood, however as all members of the royal family are currently deceased, there is no way to check if she actually is part of one.
Edited from Re:Zero Wiki
Age: Over 400 years

A mysterious mage who was contracted by Roswaal to keep his ancient magical tomes safe in his enormous library. She has the ability to warp any room in the mansion to this library whenever she chooses, but can't completely leave the mansion. Despite her cold behavior and verbal abuse towards Subaru, Beatrice can't stand if people are hurt in front of her and becomes one of people that Subaru can trust. She is affectionate towards Pack because of their similarities and favors him over the others in the Roswaal household. Ends all of her sentences with "-kashira".
Edited from both Wikipedia & Re:Zero Wiki

segments.text: The head of Karsten house, which is known to have strong ties to the late royal family, and one of the candidates for the royal election to become the 42nd King of Lugnica. Crusch's ideal is free the country from the centuries long heavy dependency on the Dragon's guidance which she believe has led Luginca into stagnation and stripped the country's will to govern without it, betraying the hopes of the conservative ruling class who pin her as favorite to win the election. Crusch is honest, sincere, right, being a type of person who is destined to stand above others, though she has talent and has worked hard to reach where she is now. She prefers to act herself and has the pride of a warrior, but is also very dense and often believes the false knowledge jokingly told to her by Ferris, and sometimes displays an airheaded side.
Edited from both Wikipedia & Re:Zero Wiki

segments.text: One of the candidates for the royal election to become the 42nd King of Lugnica and head of Barielle House. Priscilla has an extravagant self-centered personality, because of how much the world turns into her favor. Even though she is only 19, Priscilla has had 8 husbands who have all mysteriously died, despite that the lands she has acquired have prospered under her thanks to her almost supernatural good luck at guessing.

segments.text: One of the candidates for the royal election to become the 42nd King of Luginca. She is the head of the famous Hoshin Trading Company and has billed as second coming of Hoshin of the Wilderness for her near unprecedented success. Anastasia likes when people benefit while she benefits, despite her greed and lust for money as an orphan, and is actually sympathetic. She hails from Kararagi which lies west of Lugnica, where its inhabitants speak in kansai dialect; Anastasia is no exception.

segments.text: An easygoing Royal Guard knight and holder of the title "Sword Saint", who easily becomes friends with Subaru. He exhibits extraordinary powers in combat, and is stronger than all of his predecessors. After discovering that Emilia's insignia reacted to Felt, Reinhard becomes Felt's knight for the royal election. He, the Dragon, and Satella are the three most powerful characters in the world of the series.

segments.text: Roswaal is the lord of the Roswaal Mansion and the greatest magician in Lugnica. He comes across as an eccentric due to his flamboyant appearance and odd speaking style, the latter which he shares with his grandmother. However, he harbors a more calculating and reserved side with a sharp political mind and gaze that reads others quite well.

Roswaal cares about his main maids, Ram and Rem a great deal and holds them in high regard among his staff. However, he is unusual among the nobility for having such close relations with Demi-humans to the point that many are hired by him. This has led to unsavory rumors that have suggested he has a fetish for them.
From Re:Zero Wiki

segments.text: Ferris is Crusch's knight and a healer, as well as a demi human. Ferris usually refers to himself in third person, calling himself Ferri-chan, though he will refer to himself as Ferris, Felix, or with female pronouns depending on the situation. He is absolutely loyal to Crusch and will do anything she says, however he will oppose her if needed. He also enjoys teasing other people, especially those that are surprised that he's male, using cutesy language and gestures to agitate them.

Although he hides it through his actions and words, Ferris has a severe view on death and values due to his job as a healer, leading him to hold those who no longer have any will to live in contempt from the bottom of his heart. He also hates weaklings because of his complex, causing him to hate Subaru for a while, however he lets go of his feelings against him after seeing his actions during the battle against the White Whale. He is also constantly thankful for Crusch and everything that she's done for him in her life.
From Re:Zero Wiki

segments.text: Wilhelm is a member of the Crusch Camp and Reinhard's grandfather. Aside from being Crusch's servant, he also acts as her sword instructor. In his youth, he fought in the Demi-Human War, where he earned the title of Sword Devil. After his wife Theresia was killed by the White Whale, he vowed to avenge her.

Wilhelm is a refined man with a highly gentle and humble demeanor. However, underneath that even temperament is a fierce warrior who often is the first to help when something happens. This wasn't always the case, as in his youth, Wilhelm was the very opposite of who he was in his later years.: brash, afoot, short tempered, lonely, and often cold with others. He was a troubled individual who devoted himself wholly to the sword and cared for little else. Even so, he knew how to analyze a situation, always finding a way out. Nonetheless, Theresia greatly influenced his personality, which caused him to become increasingly sociable and protective, achieving more results during the Demi-human War. It was through her most of all that he would become the person he is today.
From Re:Zero Wiki
Al is Priscilla's knight. Initially introduced as Priscilla's constantly abused "knight", it is soon revealed that there might be more to him,
following the revelation that, like Subaru, he was summoned to this world from Japan roughly 18 years ago

. Although very skilled at fighting due to the time spent in Vollachia, Aldebaran does not like to make enemies, as he considers that taking care of them when a problem occurs requires a lot of work, but Priscilla doesn't seem to care about this.
Al has a frivolous and goofy personality, and
having spent more than ten years in a different world, he was easily able to get along with Subaru

. Despite being Priscilla's knight, he doesn't really recognize himself as one, seeing himself as her caretaker, while Priscilla herself sees him as a handyman and a jester to entertain her. He has no qualms about their relationship. He also brags that the only way he can fight is by outwitting people and catching them by surprise.
Despite his easygoing attitude, Al is deeply affected by having a form of amnesia. Until he met Subaru he sometimes had episodes where he would think of himself as losing the plot
due to the memories he had from Earth
. It's unknown how Al's amnesia came to be.
From Re:Zero Wiki

segments.text: Julius is Anastasia's knight and a member of the Royal Guard. He is one of Reinhard's best friends. He and Subaru initially started out on the wrong foot, due to their seemingly incompatible personalities. However, it didn't turn truly antagonistic until Subaru offended the whole Royal Knight garrison, prompting him to publicly humiliate him in a mock duel. Later on following the battle with the White Whale, their relationship got better after they both apologized.

As a member of Lugnica's nobility, Julius acts in a proper fashion, always having an air of nobility and conviction. He is also considerate and doesn't forget to show care toward others. He also shows a strict side, giving out accurate assessments of others whether they're good or bad, which is a result of his upbringing as an elite, and in actuality, he believes that he and others can do better than they currently are.
From Re:Zero Wiki

segments.text: A member of Felt Camp whom Felt calls "Old Man Rom". He has taken care of Felt for a long time. Rom is a good-natured giant, with honest intentions when it comes to evaluating trinkets. He is a known alcoholic and frequents the enjoyments of drinking. When it comes to strangers, he isn't afraid of them, and he has a high awareness when it comes to sensing hostility.
From Re:Zero Wiki
